comments.author: @DC6B79
comments.text:
J. Ross MacKay was a prof at UBC when I was fortunate enough to attend one of his lectures on this subject. That would have been in the early 70’s. Fast forward 10 years where I spent several years in that world on land, sea and in the air. I know and care about the people and their country.

Quibbles: phonetically it’s “mackai” and “bowfort”.

Quibbles aside, my thanks for this.

replies.author: @nigelcornwell2227
replies.text: I took Geography 101 at UBC in 1970, and our prof was an expert in Arctic geography.  His name was Dr. John Stager and I still remember his lectures on Arctic ice - permafrost, pingos, ice polygons ....

replies.text: Hearing Mackay lecture and then spending years in the region must have been quite an experience. Thanks for sharing that, and for the pronunciation pointers. I appreciate you watching!
